rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an intimate romantic relationship or love affair.

example.english: I have a romance with him.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 jau5 dyun6 lyun2 oi3 gwaan1 hai6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a love story in a book, film, or other narrative.

example.english: I like watching this romance the most.
example.traditional: 我最鍾意睇呢套愛情故事。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 tai2 ni1 tou3 oi3 cing4 gu3 si6

rows.note: Use this when the romance means a strong attachment or obsession with someone or something.

example.english: My romance with old records is something even my friends laugh about.
example.traditional: 我對舊唱片嘅迷戀，朋友都笑我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 gau6 coeng3 pin2 ge3 mai4 lyun2 pang4 jau5 dou1 siu3 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for an idealized romantic feeling or the evocative charm associated with a place or experience.

example.english: This old cinema has a real romance to it.
example.traditional: 呢間老戲院好有浪漫情懷。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 lou5 hei3 jyun2 hou2 jau5 long6 maan6 cing4 waai4
